name: bim-bridge
description: Connect Kimi Code to the local BIM Bridge Runtime for safe Revit and AutoCAD automation.
author: BIM Bridge

interface.shortDescription: Control Revit and AutoCAD through BIM Bridge
interface.longDescription: Checks the installed BIM Bridge Host, exposes its existing MCP tools to Kimi Code, and guides bounded Autodesk reads, previewed writes, readback, and visual verification.
